Archive Control PostureLink

Control FieldCurrent StandardFounder Use
Layer statusRetained history and closeout control layerUse this hub to confirm what is closed, what is retrievable, and what must not be reopened casually.
Primary purposePreserve final matter history after active execution has ended.Keeps prior decisions reconstructable without polluting live CRM, operations, compliance, or dashboard rooms.
Release ruleNothing leaves the active layer until closeout evidence, residual risk, and retrieval ownership are clear.Blocks archive from becoming a parking lot for unresolved work.
Retrieval ruleEvery archived matter should tell a future reviewer what happened, where final records live, and who owns retrieval.Makes archive useful for founder memory, audits, relationship review, and operating lessons.
Protection ruleArchive cleanup must not edit protected template masters or approved brand assets.Preserves master-template and brand-control integrity while retained history matures.

Archive Readiness GateLink

GatePass StandardFounder Decision Use
Active ownership clearedThe live owner confirms no open task can still change commercial, operational, financial, compliance, claim, release, or retrieval outcome.Determines whether the record can leave active operating control.
Evidence chain completeFinal deal, shipment, document-control, release, funding, compliance, decision, and dashboard routes agree when applicable.Prevents archive finality from relying on memory or folder placement alone.
Residual risk namedAny watch item, precedent boundary, retrieval condition, or future-reference constraint is explicit.Keeps future founder review from overstating what the closed matter proves.
Retrieval owner assignedA named functional owner can recover final records without searching blindly.Makes retained history operationally usable.
Closeout standard confirmedThe matter meets 05_sops/07_archive/Archive-Closeout-SOP.md before archive release.Keeps archive release governed by procedure instead of convenience.

Retrieval and Reopen RulesLink

Retrieval NeedUse Archive WhenReturn to Active Layer When
Prior commercial contextThe founder needs final history, prior pricing logic, relationship memory, or bounded operating lessons.A new commercial opportunity, negotiation, or customer action is being created.
Shipment or release proofThe founder needs to reconstruct what happened after closeout.Movement, filing, payment, or release facts can still change.
Compliance or CAPA learningThe founder needs retained prevention, traceability, or regulatory history.Inspection, claim, CAPA, supplier approval, or regulatory posture is still open.
Exception precedentThe founder needs to understand why an exception was contained.A current matter wants to reuse the exception logic without fresh approval.
Audit or financing supportA retained record must support external diligence or audit memory.Missing evidence requires owner follow-through or source-record repair.

Protection and Escalation RulesLink

TriggerRequired ActionArchive Protection
A source record contradicts archive finalityKeep the record in proof-watch posture until sources agree.Protects trust in retained history.
A live task, claim, payment, release, or compliance item remains openReturn the matter to the active layer before archive release.Prevents unresolved work from disappearing.
A future matter cites archived exception logic as precedentRequire founder decision, risk, integrity, and executable-check comparison before reuse.Prevents past exceptions from becoming default operating behavior.
Retrieval requires blind searching across foldersAdd route-backed retrieval ownership before archive finality.Keeps archive founder-readable and audit-ready.
Archive cleanup touches protected templates or approved brand assetsStop and preserve the protected source; create or update only live working records.Maintains template and brand protections.
